stem.text: A uniform resistance wire XY of length $100\,\text{cm}$ is connected in series with a cell L. Another cell M is connected in series with resistors of resistances $5.00\,\Omega$, $10.0\,\Omega$ and $15.0\,\Omega$.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram: a uniform resistance wire XY with cell L and cell M, resistors 5.00 Ω, 10.0 Ω and 15.0 Ω, an ammeter (A), and points P, Q, R, S and X, Y. Printed labels: 100 cm, 12.5 cm, resistance wire.

stem.text: The potential difference (p.d.) between P and Q is balanced against $12.5\,\text{cm}$ of the resistance wire, so that the ammeter reads zero.
The p.d. across the other resistors is then balanced against other lengths of the resistance wire.
Which balanced lengths of resistance wire correspond to the connection points given in the table?
